def solve(times: List[str]) -> str:
    # Convert times to minutes since midnight
    def time_to_minutes(time: str) -> int:
        hours, minutes = map(int, time.split(':'))

        hours = minutes // 60
        minutes = minutes % 60
        return f"{hours:02}:{minutes:02}"
